stemBlocks: A horizontal, uniform bar of mass 60 kg is 4.0 m long and is pivoted at one end. The bar is held in equilibrium by a force $F$ at the other end of the bar, acting at an angle of $60^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. Which expression gives the magnitude of $F$ in newtons? (gravitational field strength = $10 \text{ N kg}^{-1}$)
